issue.title: Record the batched-merge process in CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md
issue.body:
The owner's decisions of 2026-11-17 (#665 issuecomment-6939460730 and issuecomment-6939574513) replace repeated sync rounds with batched merges: two positive reviews per PR at its own head, freeze, one composition, one composition review, one full candidate on the composed tree, one merge.

Record this as standing process:
- a new CONTRIBUTING.md section 2.3 "Batched merges";
- pointers and amendments in CONTRIBUTING.md 2.1, AGENTS.md sections 6, 7 and 8, and docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md (Fast feedback).

**Landing:** on dev now, as docs only. On dev-soft-core as the first unbatched change after the flip train's single merge.

**Follow-up:** after the first batch merge, check that the containment and review-integrity checks judge member PRs marked merged by ancestry.

Relates to #665.

decisions.body:
[A10] **Owner decision, 2026-11-17 06:25: option B, one train candidate for the flip train.** Recorded here; it amends the per-PR candidate rule for this train only.

1. **Each PR** still needs both reviews POSITIVE at its exact head (an ancestor POSITIVE counts where the other reviewer covers the later delta, as before). Each is synced onto the train where its merge would conflict.
2. **Once all ten are approved** (#881, #914, #918, #934, #935, #933, #938, #931, #932, #936), the manager composes them in train order on live dev-soft-core, recording every planned merge's tree.
3. **One full candidate** (builder bank plus full native bank) runs on the final composed tree. The gating S12b runs on that same tree's images in parallel.
4. **The PRs then merge in order.** After each merge, its resulting tree must equal the planned tree, or the train stops. The last merge's tree must equal the candidate's tree.
5. **Any fix to a PR after composition** rebuilds the composition and reruns the train candidate.
6. **The flip PR** keeps its own full candidate and review.

**What this gives up:** the intermediate trees get no full candidate of their own. Only the final tree, which is the one shipped and benched, does. **Target:** the flip PR on Thursday 11-19.

[A10] **Way of working for the flip train, from now on** (owner, 2026-11-17 06:4x: avoid reviews and rounds that the next merge breaks anyway). This builds on option B (issuecomment-6939460730).

1. **Freeze.** A PR with two POSITIVE reviews at its own reviewed head is frozen. It gets no sync round onto dev-soft-core and no re-review after a sync. It changes only for a defect in its own change.
2. **Compose once.** One composition lane builds a train branch on live dev-soft-core, merging each frozen PR in train order with `--no-ff` and resolving every conflict there. It re-measures the composed image at 1x1/1if and 8x8/1if (the CPU service-budget harness, the in-tree statement survey, the ROM ledger) and fixes only what composition breaks.
3. **Check once.**
   - one composition review, by both reviewers, on the conflict resolutions and the composed measurements only;
   - one train candidate, the full banks, on the train tip;
   - the gating S12b on the same images.
4. **Merge once.** The train branch merges into dev-soft-core in a single merge. Each constituent PR's head is then contained in the base, so GitHub marks it merged.
5. **After composition,** any finding is fixed in the composition lane.

**Applied now:**
- #881's sync round is stopped; the PR is frozen at `d3e61e37`, both reviews positive. Its local resolution is kept for the composition lane.
- Rounds that fix a PR's own change continue: #914 round 12, #934 round 5, #936 and #932 round 3.

Frozen so far: #881, #918, #935, #933, #938, #931.
